title: Google Cloud Skill Boost Profile
description: Google's official online learning platform offering on-demand, hands-on training, labs, and courses for building skills in Google Cloud technologies and AI/ML, allowing users to earn shareable Skill Badges and prepare for Google Cloud certifications.
